en.content: Which one of the following pairs of isomers is an example of metamerism?
en.explanation:
Metamers are compounds which have different alkyl groups present along both side of polyvalent functional group.

No polyvalent functional group in option (a).

The two functional groups are different in option (b).

Alcohol is not a polyvalent functional group.

Alkyl groups are different along both sides of polyvalent functional group.

en.content:
A solution is 0.1 M in Cl and 0.001 M in CrO. Solid AgNO3 is gradually added to it. Assuming that the addition does not change in volume and Ksp(AgCl) = 1.7 1010 M2 and Ksp(Ag2CrO4) = 1.9 1012 M3.

Select correct statement from the following :

options.content: AgCl precipitates first because its K<sub>sp</sub> is high.
Ag<sub>2</sub>CrO<sub>4</sub> precipitates first as its K<sub>sp</sub> is low.
Ag<sub>2</sub>CrO<sub>4</sub> precipitates first because the amount of Ag<sup>+</sup> needed is low.
AgCl will precipitate first as the amount of Ag<sup>+</sup> needed to precipitate is low.

en.explanation:
Conc. of Cl = 0.1 M = 101 M

Conc. of CrO = 0.001 M = 103 M

Ksp(AgCl) = [Ag+][Cl]

[Ag+]AgCl =





AgCl will be precipitate first

hi.content:
एक विलयन Cl में 0.1 M और CrO में 0.001 M है। धीरे-धीरे इसमें ठोस AgNO3 मिलाया जाता है। यह मानते हुए कि इसके जोड़ने से आयतन में कोई परिवर्तन नहीं होता है और Ksp(AgCl) = 1.7 1010 M2 और Ksp(Ag2CrO4) = 1.9 1012 M3 है।

निम्नलिखित में से सही कथन का चयन करें :

options.content: AgCl पहले बसता है क्योंकि इसका K<sub>sp</sub> उच्च है।
Ag<sub>2</sub>CrO<sub>4</sub> पहले बसता है क्योंकि इसका K<sub>sp</sub> कम है।
Ag<sub>2</sub>CrO<sub>4</sub> पहले बसता है क्योंकि Ag<sup>+</sup> की आवश्यक मात्रा कम है।
AgCl पहले बसेगा क्योंकि बसाने के लिए Ag<sup>+</sup> की आवश्यक मात्रा कम है।
